q1.question: How can I register for a tournament?

answer.intro: To register for a tournament, follow these steps:
answer.step1: Create an account or log in to your existing account
answer.step2: Go to the tournament page you're interested in
answer.step3: Click on the "Register for tournament" button
answer.step4: Follow the instructions to complete your registration
answer.outro: Depending on the tournament, you may need to provide additional information such as your game ID.

q2.question: How do I create or join a team?

answer.createTeamDesc: When registering for a team tournament, select "Create a new team" and give your team a name.
answer.joinTeamDesc: Ask the team captain to send you an invitation. You will receive it in your profile under the "Invitations" tab.
answer.outro: The team captain can invite up to 7 members depending on the tournament format.

q3.question: What are the participation requirements for minors?

answer.requirement1: A signed parental consent is required when registering on the platform
answer.requirement2: Some tournaments may have additional age restrictions (16+ or 13+)
answer.requirement3: Minors under 13 cannot participate in our tournaments in accordance with GDPR
answer.outro: The parental consent document must be uploaded in PDF format when creating your account.

q4.question: How are tournament prizes paid out?

answer.intro: Prize payment depends on the type of tournament:
answer.onlineTournamentsDesc: Prizes are paid via bank transfer or PayPal within 30 days of the tournament end
answer.physicalTournamentsDesc: Prizes can be handed out in person or via transfer
answer.requirement: To receive your prizes, you will need to provide the necessary information in your profile (bank details or PayPal email).
answer.note: Note: Taxes may apply depending on your country of residence.

q5.question: Which countries are eligible to participate in tournaments?

answer.intro: Each tournament has its own geographic restrictions:
answer.option1: Some tournaments are open to all countries
answer.option2: Others are limited to specific regions (Africa, Europe, etc.)
answer.option3: Restrictions are always clearly indicated on the tournament page
answer.outro: These restrictions may be due to legal reasons, latency issues, or constraints imposed by sponsors.

answer.phase3Desc: Often streamed live on our Twitch channel
answer.notification: You will be notified by email of your match schedules. Always log in 15 minutes before the scheduled time.

q7.question: I encountered a technical problem during my match, what should I do?

answer.step1: Immediately contact the tournament administrator via the dedicated Discord channel
answer.step2: Provide proof of the problem (screenshots, recordings)
answer.step3: Do not abandon your match without instruction from the administrator
answer.decision: Administrators' decisions regarding technical problems are final.
answer.warning: If you do not report the problem during the match, no subsequent claim will be accepted.

q8.question: How can I stream my matches on my personal channel?

answer.intro: You can stream your own matches under certain conditions:
answer.requirement1: You must request prior authorization via the form available in your participant area
answer.requirement2: A minimum 2-minute streaming delay must be respected for competitive tournaments
answer.requirement3: The Orange Arena logo must appear in your overlay
answer.requirement4: You cannot stream exclusive matches (finals, semi-finals) reserved for our official channels
answer.resources: Download our streaming kit from the "Resources" section to get the necessary logos and graphics.

q9.question: How do I report inappropriate behavior from another participant?

answer.intro: We take participant behavior very seriously:
answer.step1: Use the "Report" button available on the participant's profile
answer.step3: Our moderation team will review the report within 24 hours
answer.behaviors: Inappropriate behaviors include: cheating, hate speech, harassment, and unsportsmanlike conduct.
answer.sanctions: Sanctions can range from warnings to permanent exclusion from the platform.

q10.question: Can I cancel my tournament registration?

answer.intro: Yes, you can cancel your registration under certain conditions:
answer.free: For free tournaments: cancellation possible up to 24 hours before the start
answer.paid: For paid tournaments: refund possible up to 72 hours before the start (administrative fees non-refundable)
answer.team: For team tournaments: only the captain can cancel the team's registration
answer.howTo: To cancel, go to your profile, "My Tournaments" section and click "Cancel Registration".
answer.warning: Repeated cancellations may result in restrictions on your future registrations.

q11.question: Why do I need to connect my Discord account for certain tournaments?

answer.reason1Desc: The Discord server allows for fast and efficient communication during the tournament
answer.reason2Desc: Schedule changes, rules, and last-minute information
answer.reason3Desc: Administrators can help you quickly in case of problems
answer.reason4Desc: Meet other players and form teams
answer.howToStep1: Go to your profile and click "Edit Profile"
answer.howToStep2: In the "Discord Account" section, click "Link Discord Account"
answer.howToStep3: Authorize the application to access your Discord account
answer.howToStep4: Join the tournament Discord server via the provided link
answer.howToStep5: Verification of your membership will be done automatically
